osaka_iwai_bettei_kitashinchi.gf_detail: Ask when booking. No gluten information. Courses combine sushi with tempura (wheat batter) and side dishes such as a fish katsu sandwich (July 2026); sushi is usually served with soy sauce or a soy glaze, which normally contains wheat.
osaka_iwai_bettei_kitashinchi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: set courses of sushi, seafood and tempura.
osaka_iwai_bettei_kitashinchi.hours_raw: Mon–Fri 11:30–14:00 and 17:00–23:00; Sat, Sun and holidays 11:30–14:00 and 16:00–23:00; closing days not fixed (Tabelog; official site). Reservations accepted; phone cancellations are not taken outside business hours (Tabelog). Service charge 10% (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners); no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 20 seats: counter and private rooms for 2, 4 and 6; whole-shop hire up to 20; non-smoking; children welcome (Tabelog). Opened 10 September 2023 (Tabelog).
osaka_iwai_bettei_kitashinchi.notes: [Sushi · Kitashinchi, sushi and tempura in one course] The Kitashinchi branch of Iwai, a group that grew from a tempura and wine restaurant in Ashiya whose Michelin star two years running made its name (official site); here the tempura shares a course with Edo-style sushi. Weekday lunch starts at a ¥4,990 nigiri set and climbs to a ¥9,990 premium omakase with tempura, which makes it one of the gentler ways into a Kitashinchi counter; at dinner diners report spending ¥10,000–14,999 (Tabelog). Courses open with small seasonal dishes (Akashi octopus, a fruit-tomato frappé, steamed abalone in August 2026), then tempura and nigiri such as kombu-cured sea bream, seared kinmedai and toro. Diners describe a chef who talks diners through each dish and puts nervous first-timers at ease; the tempura is soft rather than crisp, which a June 2026 diner did not care for and a July 2026 diner called a matter of taste. Private rooms for two to six (a December 2025 diner booked one for a business dinner); tell the chef if you are short of time. Service charge 10%.

roles: Head chef (unnamed), who explains each dish (July 2026 review)
chef_bio.origin: Branch of 鮨 天ぷら いわい, which began in Ashiya, Hyogo as 天ぷら&ワイン いわい (official site).
chef_bio.background: Group site (read 2026-11-01): the original Ashiya restaurant earned a Michelin star two years running ("ミシュランガイドで2年連続一つ星を獲得"), then opened in Gion (Kyoto), Ginza (Tokyo), Hiroshima and elsewhere, some shops adding Edo-style sushi; the shops listed now are Kitashinchi, Hiroshima, Gion, Kichijoji and Ginza. The group's owner (店主, unnamed) holds wine-sommelier and vegetable-sommelier qualifications, grew up in a family that ran a Japanese restaurant, and has long hotel experience. The Tabelog listing calls this shop the Kitashinchi opening of the Michelin-listed "Ashiya Iwai"; the group site lists the same address as 北新地 鮨 天ぷら いわい. In 2026 reviews the owner is "very approachable" (August) and the head chef explains each dish (July).
chef_bio.philosophy: "自然の物語を天ぷらに閉じ込める" — sealing nature's story into tempura, with seasonal produce (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Sushi and tempura in one course.

anecdotes.text: "As soon as we were seated, the chef kindly engaged us in conversation, helping my wife, who is usually shy, to relax." — August 2026, a second visit, with family.
"Given the location, the staff is mindful of time, so if you're in a hurry, it might be a good idea to inform the chef in advance!" — July 2026, a family celebration on the ¥10,000 course.
"Since we were seated at the counter, we could watch the sushi being prepared right in front of us" — October 2026, lunch on the Omakase Premium Course.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 鮨 天ぷら いわい、兵庫県芦屋市の「天ぷら&ワイン いわい」から始まり、ミシュランガイドで2年連続一つ星、その後祇園、銀座、広島などに出店、一部の店では江戸前寿司も、店主はワインソムリエと野菜ソムリエの資格を持ち、日本料理店が生家でホテルでの経験も豊富、店舗は北新地、広島、祇園、吉祥寺、銀座。北新地の店: 大阪市北区曽根崎新地1-9-11 1F、ランチ11:30〜14:00、ディナー17:00〜23:00 (土日祝16:00〜23:00)、不定休、サービス料10%。食べログ (店舗会員): 北新地 鮨 天ぷら いわい 別邸、北新地駅から徒歩2分、平日限定ランチのにぎりのセット4,990円、ランチのおまかせ6,990円、天ぷらつきの Premium Omakase 9,990円、20席、個室2・4・6名、禁煙、子ども可、2023年9月10日オープン。口コミ (2026年1〜10月): 1万円のコース、6,990円のコース、前菜、天ぷら、握り、いくらの小さな丼、茶碗蒸し、大将が料理を説明して緊張をほぐしてくれる、珍しい日本酒とビール、天ぷらはさくさくではなくやわらかめ、急ぐなら先に伝えて。

osaka_sushi_sogoro_kitashinchi.gf_detail: Ask when booking. No gluten information. Course dishes include spring rolls (wheat wrappers) and a thickened ankake dashi sauce (September 2026); nigiri is usually finished with soy sauce or a glaze, which normally contains wheat.
osaka_sushi_sogoro_kitashinchi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: an omakase course of fish, shellfish and sushi.
osaka_sushi_sogoro_kitashinchi.hours_raw: Daily 11:30–14:00 and 17:00–23:00, holidays included (Tabelog); "Closed: None" (September 2026 review). Reservations needed (December 2024 review); the shop may not answer the phone during service, so book online (Tabelog). A year-end surcharge applies 24–31 December 2026 and 1–11 January 2027 (¥1,000 dinner, ¥500 lunch; Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master); no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 7 counter seats, all with chairs; non-smoking; no children below junior-high age; go easy on perfume (Tabelog). Opened 28 November 2013 (Tabelog).
osaka_sushi_sogoro_kitashinchi.notes: [Sushi · Kitashinchi main street, seven seats] A seven-seat counter on Kitashinchi's main street that began as a standing sushi bar; the sign still said so in December 2024, but everyone sits now. The chef picks the fish each morning, the rice is cooked in a clay pot and seasoned with red vinegar, and the monthly omakase mixes inventive small plates with small, easy nigiri: in September 2026, a butternut-squash potage with crab, seared bonito with a corn sauce, ayu spring rolls, sanma sushi heaped with ikura, then about ten nigiri including oyster, marinated tuna and fluffy anago. At ¥13,200 for dinner (lunch ¥6,600 or ¥8,800), diners call it remarkably reasonable for Kitashinchi. The chef is friendly and full of jokes, described in a December 2024 review as multilingual. One December 2025 diner felt rushed by sushi piling up; on a return in September 2026 the same diner found the service much improved. Seats are close together. No children below junior-high age; book ahead.

roles: Chef (unnamed), who chooses the fish each morning (Tabelog; December 2024 review)
Owner (unnamed; mentioned in a September 2026 review)
chef_bio.background: Opened on 28 November 2013 (Tabelog); first a standing sushi bar, now seated (reviews, December 2024 and September 2026). Tabelog Sushi WEST 100, 2021. The shop text: sushi has become more exclusive over time, and the shop aims to bring back the casualness and joy of sushi's origins, travelling the country to choose ingredients (Tabelog). Diners describe a "friendly and skilled chef" who "runs the establishment with charm" (September 2026), a chef "sharing some silly jokes to lighten the mood" (September 2026), and a "multilingual and friendly chef" (December 2024); a June 2024 diner heard that the chef is "quite the eccentric cook".
chef_bio.philosophy: To recreate the casualness and joy of sushi's origins and show each ingredient at its best (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Monthly omakase of small plates and nigiri on red-vinegar rice.

anecdotes.text: "Next was the Katsuo no Tataki. I was told to enjoy it with a sauce made from corn paste... I thought it was a bold dish, but it paired perfectly and was delicious!" — September 2026, the ¥13,200 course.
"Although it mentions standing sushi, you can now enjoy it seated at a leisurely pace." — September 2026, the ¥12,000 omakase (before tax).
"I visited after 9 months, and it seems there has been some training implemented. The service has significantly improved." — September 2026, a return after a December 2025 visit that felt rushed.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): 鮨 惣五郎、大阪市北区曽根崎新地1-3-32 新地リバティービル 1F、北新地駅から徒歩2分、毎日11:30〜14:00、17:00〜23:00、営業中は電話に出られないことがあるのでネット予約を、おまかせ13,200円、ランチ6,600円と8,800円 (税込、月替わり)、年末年始は追加料金、カード (VISA、Master)、カウンター7席 (すべて椅子)、禁煙、中学生未満は不可、香水は控えめに、毎朝仕入れる食材、土鍋で炊くご飯、2013年11月28日オープン、寿司 WEST 百名店 2021。口コミ (2024年6月〜2026年10月): 赤酢のシャリ、小ぶりの握り、かぼちゃのポタージュ、カツオとコーンのソース、鮎の春巻き、いくらをのせたサンマの鮨、はもと茄子の松茸あんかけ、牡蠣の握り、もとは立ち鮨で今は座って食べる、冗談の好きな気さくな大将、2025年12月に急かされたと感じた人が2026年9月にはサービスがよくなったと書いている。

osaka_critters_burger_nishishinsaibashi.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Every burger comes on the house bun of Hokkaido wheat (Kansai Walker 2018; a September 2026 review), and pancakes, fries and onion rings fill out the menu; no gluten-free bun is described.
osaka_critters_burger_nishishinsaibashi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the burgers are built on an all-beef patty with mayonnaise, bacon, cheese or egg, and no meat-free burger appears in the sources read.
osaka_critters_burger_nishishinsaibashi.hours_raw: Daily 11:00–22:00, last order 21:00; weekday lunch 11:00–16:00; open all year (Tabelog). Reservations only for the evening, from 18:00; walk in at lunch, when a few groups may be waiting at opening (Tabelog; September–October 2026). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners) for bills over ¥5,000, e-money and QR payments; PayPay (Tabelog; October 2026 review). 25 seats, tables only; smoking allowed from 17:00, non-smoking until then; pets allowed; take-out (Tabelog). Opened 23 May 2009 (Tabelog).
osaka_critters_burger_nishishinsaibashi.notes: [Burgers · Amerikamura, a pioneer since 2009] A wood-fronted American burger house in Amerikamura that opened in 2009, before gourmet burgers had caught on in Kansai, and has been in Tabelog's Hamburger 100 seven times since 2017. The bun is the point: made from Hokkaido wheat and natural yeast at the sister bakery, toasted, fluffy inside and firm enough to hold the juicy all-beef patty to the last bite. Order the double cheeseburger (¥2,365 in October 2026), or the spinach bacon burger, the house favourite since at least 2018. Expect a few groups waiting at the 11:00 opening and many overseas visitors; evening tables can be booked from 18:00. Note that smoking is allowed from 17:00.

chef_bio.background: Per Kansai Walker (2018): the representative 栗田宗太朗 went to an international school hoping to study at an American university, then trained at an architecture college, qualified as an architect and worked three or four years as a site supervisor for a housebuilder. The father, a programmer, baked bread as a hobby and opened a bakery near the family home, baking every morning while the mother sold the bread; the younger brother, three years younger, came in to help. The brothers decided to make burgers with that bread, ran a mobile stall for about a year around 淀屋橋 and at festivals, and opened the shop in Shinsaibashi, an area known since high school, in 2009 with 20 burgers on the menu. The first two years were hard and delivery kept the shop going. When the family bakery could no longer keep up with the buns, West Wood Bakers opened in 2013, then The Pie Shop in 2016 (Kansai Walker). Time Out (2025) calls it a pioneer of high-end beef burgers in Osaka. Tabelog Hamburger 100 in 2017, 2018, 2019, 2021, 2022, 2024 and 2026.
chef_bio.philosophy: "Bring American food culture to Japan and serve it with an arrangement of our own" (Kansai Walker 2018, translated).
chef_bio.specialty: Spinach bacon burger; double cheeseburger; house buns of Hokkaido wheat.

anecdotes.text: "The bun was fluffy on top and firmer on the bottom, with a slight sweetness from the bread and richness from the cheese" — October 2026, a Double Cheeseburger for JPY 2,365 on a Sunday at 5:50 PM; full 15 minutes later.
"The music playing in the restaurant happened to be my favorite Southern American artists like Dr. John and Lynyrd Skynyrd" — September 2026, a spinach bacon burger before a concert.
"I entered the restaurant a bit hesitantly, but I was warmly welcomed." — September 2026, the mozzarella mushroom burger lunch set.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 関西ウォーカー (ウォーカープラス、2018年): クリッターズバーガー、まだ関西にグルメバーガーの波が来ていなかった2009年から関西のハンバーガー界を牽引、代表の栗田宗太朗さん、高校はインターナショナルスクール、建築の専門学校で建築士の資格、ハウスメーカーの現場監督を3、4年、プログラマーの父が趣味でパンを作り家の近所にパン屋、毎朝父が焼き母が売る、3つ下の弟が手伝い、兄弟でハンバーガーを作ることに、淀屋橋やフェスで移動販売を約1年、心斎橋に路面店、メニューは最初から20種、最初の2年は苦労してデリバリーで食いつなぐ、2013年にウエストウッドベーカーズ、2016年にザ パイ ショップ、バンズは姉妹店で焼く北海道産小麦100%のブレンドと天然酵母の長時間発酵、パティは牛100%つなぎなし、国産牛と輸入牛のブレンド、ソースは使わずマヨネーズとマスタードのみ、人気ナンバーワンはスピナッチ（ホウレンソウ）ベーコンバーガー、ベーコンエッグパンケーキも人気、テーブル席のみ、テラス席、創業2009年5月23日。公式サイト: 大阪市中央区西心斎橋一丁目10-35 1階、無休、姉妹店 Critters Pizza、West Wood Bakers、The Pie Shop。食べログ (店舗会員): 毎日11:00〜22:00 (L.O. 21:00)、平日ランチ11:00〜16:00、夜のみ予約可 (18時以降)、カードは5,000円以上、電子マネー・QR可、25席、17時まで禁煙でその後は喫煙可、ペット可、テイクアウト可、ハンバーガー 百名店 2017〜2019・2021・2022・2024・2026。口コミ(2026年8月〜10月): ダブルチーズバーガー2,365円、トーストしたふわふわのバンズ、ジューシーなパティ、ほうれん草とベーコンのバーガー、開店時から数組が待つ、海外の客が多い。

cultural_comfort.note: A photo menu at the entrance (October 2026); many overseas visitors (August and October 2026); covered in English by Time Out. No English menu evidence found.

osaka_cafe_basara_kaerudo_kitahorie.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. The house curry is a thick sauce simmered for 100 hours with no stated ingredients, and much of the menu is breaded or wrapped: katsu curry, croquettes, fried vegetables, omurice with demi-glace, curry ramen; the monthly Inaka Gozen has included grilled fresh wheat gluten (July 2026).
osaka_cafe_basara_kaerudo_kitahorie.vegan_detail: Ask. No vegan information. There is a vegetable curry (September 2026), the monthly Inaka Gozen is mostly vegetables (July 2026), and the omurice can come with a soy-milk cream sauce (September 2026), but nothing is stated about the curry base, stock or dairy.
osaka_cafe_basara_kaerudo_kitahorie.hours_raw: Mon, Tue, Fri, Sat, Sun 11:00–20:00; Wed 11:00–15:00; closed Thursday; hours may change (Tabelog). No reservations (Tabelog). Weekday lunch until 15:00 includes a free coffee or tea (July and October 2026 reviews). Lunch fills up around noon; mid-afternoon is quieter (2026 reviews). Cash only: no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog; 2026 reviews). 40 seats with sofas and a terrace; smoking only on the terrace; dogs welcome on the terrace; children welcome (Tabelog). The monthly Inaka Gozen menu is posted on Instagram at the start of each month (July 2026 review).
osaka_cafe_basara_kaerudo_kitahorie.notes: [Curry café · Kita-Horie by Nishi-Ohashi Stn] A slightly hidden, old-style café a minute from Nishi-Ohashi Station, where the smell of curry reaches the street. The curry is the reason to come: fruits and vegetables simmered for 100 hours into a thick sauce, sweet and fruity at first and then building heat. Order the Tonchi curry with grilled pork and cheese (¥1,200 in August 2026), add croquettes or a pile of fried vegetables, or have it over omurice; at weekday lunch a coffee or tea comes free, and a large rice gets a refill. The monthly Inaka Gozen of small vegetable dishes is the lighter choice. The owner cooks everything alone, so busy lunches mean a short wait (September 2026). Dogs are welcome on the terrace. Cash only. Tabelog Cafe WEST 100 in 2021, 2022 and 2025.

roles: Owner-cook, unnamed in the sources read

The BAILA blog (2024, updated 2026) calls it an old-house-style café known for a curry of fruits and vegetables simmered 100 hours, and a past Tabelog 100 shop. Tabelog Cafe WEST 100 in 2021, 2022 and 2025.
chef_bio.specialty: 100-hour curry; Tonchi curry; omurice with curry and demi-glace.

anecdotes.text: "The presentation was impressive, with fried vegetables piled high on top of the katsu." — September 2026, a katsu curry plate after 1 PM, with a short wait because the owner cooks everything alone.
"The staff kindly changed my partner's order to the large size because they were happy to see us enjoying our meal." — October 2026, on the terrace.
"The curry is simmered for 100 hours, resulting in a thick, sauce-like consistency that is wonderfully rich. It doesn't contain any chunks of ingredients." — July 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: BAILA (ブログ、2024年、2026年更新): Cafe 婆沙羅 かえる堂、「100時間煮込んだカレー」が評判の古民家風カフェ、西大橋駅から徒歩1分ほどの隠れ家、どこか懐かしい店内、ランチ時は満席になりがち、自家製オムライスに100時間煮込んだカレーとデミグラスソース、カレーはフルーツの甘い味わいのあとにジワジワ辛さ、濃厚でコクがある、ジャンバラヤのカレーがけ、カツカレー、果物と野菜をとろけるまで100時間煮込む、過去に百名店。食べログ: 大阪市西区北堀江2-2-24 PRADIPA 1F、西大橋駅3番出口から徒歩1分、月・火・金・土・日11:00〜20:00、水11:00〜15:00、木曜休み、予約不可、カード・電子マネー・QR不可、40席、ソファ席とオープンテラス、喫煙はテラス席のみ、ペットはテラス席のみ、子ども可、カフェ WEST 百名店 2021・2022・2025。口コミ(2026年7月〜10月): Tonchi カレー1,200円、プレートはサラダ、ヨーグルト、フルーツ付き、平日ランチはコーヒーか紅茶のサービス、Cheese Indian omurice 1,300円、Inaka Gozen 1,500円は月替わりで小鉢がたくさん、ライス大盛りはおかわり可、オーナーがひとりで料理を作る、テラスは犬連れ可、現金のみ。

osaka_ajinoya_honten_namba.gf_detail: Not gluten-free in practice: okonomiyaki and negiyaki are wheat-batter dishes and the yakisoba uses the house noodles; no gluten-free option described.
osaka_ajinoya_honten_namba.vegan_detail: Not vegan: every okonomiyaki, negiyaki and yakisoba on the official menu carries pork, beef, seafood, egg or cheese.
osaka_ajinoya_honten_namba.hours_raw: Tue–Sun and holidays 11:00–22:00, a full close at 22:00; closed Monday and New Year's Day, and sometimes the last Monday and Tuesday of the month (official site). Tabelog gives last order 21:30, and on Friday and Saturday 11:00–22:30 (last order 22:00). No same-day bookings and no bookings by phone or email; a TableCheck FastPass buys a timed place at the front of the queue (up to 4 people, valid 15 minutes after the slot, the whole party present, 90 minutes at busy times), and bookings through AutoReserve are void (official site). The queue is otherwise long: an hour or more at 17:00–18:00 in October 2026, with a check-in terminal outside that sends an SMS as your turn nears, and orders taken while you wait. Each okonomiyaki takes about 15 minutes to cook (official site). No cards or e-money; PayPay accepted (Tabelog). 10 counter seats and 10 tables, up to 45 people (official site; Tabelog says 50 seats); non-smoking; English menu; children welcome (Tabelog). Founded 1965 (official site).
osaka_ajinoya_honten_namba.notes: [Okonomiyaki · Namba, a queue since 1965] An okonomiyaki house founded in 1965, on a second floor opposite the stage door of the 松竹座 theatre, with a retro interior that the shop itself likens to a trip back to an old downtown okonomiyaki stand. Staff mix, pour, flip and sauce every okonomiyaki on the iron plate at your table; the batter is light, the result fluffy, sweetish sauce on top. Order the Ajinoya Mix, the tomato and cheese, or the Kujo green-onion negiyaki with beef tendon, which October 2026 diners singled out. The queue is the catch: in October 2026 an hour or more at dinner, so register at the terminal outside, walk off and come back on the text message, or buy a FastPass. In Tabelog's Okonomiyaki 100 most years since 2018, it now has two sister shops, 味乃家はなれ and 四代目味乃家, the second opened in July 2026 at the Namba Oriental Hotel.

roles: Shop manager (店舗責任者) of the main shop: 空山 嘉津子 (official site)
Operator: Ajinoya Inc.; news on the official site is signed 味乃家 店主
chef_bio.background: Founded 1965 in Namba and "passed down through four generations" (Tabelog shop text). The official site describes over 50 years of okonomiyaki grilled in front of the customer, so that diners enjoy the sizzle, the smell and the fluffy texture. Sister shops: 味乃家はなれ (reservation only, formerly the 寺田町 central kitchen, 天王寺区) and 四代目味乃家 (opened 31 July 2026 in The Namba Central Eatery, Namba Oriental Hotel 1F). Tabelog Okonomiyaki 100 in 2018, 2019, 2022, 2023, 2024 and 2025; an October 2026 diner writes that it has consistently received a Bib Gourmand.
chef_bio.philosophy: "Each one grilled with care, one at a time" (official site, translated).
chef_bio.specialty: Ajinoya Mix okonomiyaki; Kujo green-onion negiyaki with beef tendon; mix yakisoba.

anecdotes.text: "After checking in at the terminal outside, we were assigned number 19. … the restaurant has a system that sends an SMS notification to your registered phone number as your turn approaches" — October 2026, seated after about an hour.
"What stood out the most was the Kujo Negi-yaki. The abundant flavor and aroma of the Kujo green onions were exceptional" — October 2026.
"While there are many table seats, solo diners are directed to the counter." — October 2026, Ajinoya Mix for JPY 1,780 at about 4 PM on a weekday, with four people ahead.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 味乃家 本店、1965年創業、食いだおれ大阪・難波で50年以上続くお好み焼きの老舗、松竹座の向い楽屋口前、大阪市中央区難波1-7-16 現代こいさんビル 2階、店舗責任者 空山 嘉津子、カウンター席10席、テーブル10卓、最大45名、火〜日・祝11:00〜22:00 (22時に完全閉店)、月曜と元日休み、最終月曜と火曜が休みになることも、当日予約不可、電話・メールの予約不可、TableCheck の FastPass (1回1〜4名、指定時間から15分まで有効、混雑時は90分制、全員揃って来店)、AutoReserve 経由の予約は無効、焼き上がりまで約15分、2026年4月15日からメニューの一部見直しと価格改定、味乃家ミックスお好み焼き1,780円 (人気1位)、ミックス焼きそば1,980円 (人気2位)、京都九条ネギ入りネギ焼き すじ肉1,580円 (人気3位、ポン酢とゴマダレ付き)、新鮮トマトと特選チーズのお好み焼き1,780円、餅入りお好み焼き1,680円、スペシャルミックスお好み焼き3,480円、広島焼き1,580円、自家製牛すじ煮込み980円、味乃家特選Bセット5,340円 (2名向き)、税込。姉妹店に味乃家はなれ (完全予約制、旧 寺田町セントラルキッチン店、天王寺区大道2-5-11) と四代目味乃家 (2026年7月31日オープン、なんばオリエンタルホテル1階)。食べログ (店舗会員): 4代にわたる味、キャベツたっぷりで生地は軽め、ふわふわのお好み焼き、PayPay 可、カード不可、禁煙、英語メニューあり、お好み焼き 百名店 2018・2019・2022〜2025。口コミ(2026年10月): 1時間以上の行列、外の端末で受付して順番が近づくと SMS、並びながら注文、各テーブルの鉄板でスタッフが焼く、九条ネギのネギ焼きが好評、ひとり客はカウンター、海外の客も多い。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu (Tabelog); the official site has English, Chinese and Korean pages; staff cook at the table; many overseas customers (October 2026).

osaka_pesca_shinsaibashi.gf_detail: Ask when booking. No gluten information; the listing asks guests to note allergies in the booking comments. The signature "Paitza" is a pizza on flaky pastry, and pasta, baguette and cakes run through the courses; carpaccio, steak, duck and garlic rice are dishes without obvious wheat, but nothing is stated about their sauces.
osaka_pesca_shinsaibashi.vegan_detail: Ask. No vegan information. The courses are built on fish, pork, wagyu, duck and cheese; the à la carte menu is long and changes with the market, so ask what can be made without animal products.
osaka_pesca_shinsaibashi.hours_raw: Daily 15:00–24:00; closed irregularly (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; note allergies or a dessert plate with a message in the booking comments (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners; PIN needed for IC cards from April 2025) and e-money; no QR payments (Tabelog). 24 seats: about 10 at the counter, a table for four and one for six (September 2026 review); private hire for 20 to 50; non-smoking; BYO drinks possible; no minors (Tabelog). No sign on the ground floor: take the lift to the top, 10th floor and walk to the far end of the outdoor corridor (September 2026 reviews).
osaka_pesca_shinsaibashi.notes: [Italian · Nishi-Shinsaibashi, a 10th-floor hideaway] An Italian restaurant with no sign at street level: take the lift of an apartment-like building on the Amerikamura side to the top floor and walk to the end of the open corridor. Inside are a counter of about ten, two tables and soft light, with one chef at the counter, a cook behind and two people serving (September 2026). Order the carpaccio of three fish, which several 2026 diners singled out, and the "Paitza", a pizza on crisp, flaky pastry, then a pasta, such as mackerel and bottarga or duck and porcini cream. Couples, groups of friends and birthday dinners fill it, and the kitchen will write a message on the dessert plate. Tabelog puts the average at ¥5,000–5,999 a head, and the courses run ¥6,600–8,800; open from 15:00 to midnight. Tabelog Italian 100 in 2021; there is a sister shop in Namba.

roles: Chef unnamed in the sources read
chef_bio.background: Per the Tabelog shop text: "Our chefs visit the market daily to bring you unique dishes that can only be enjoyed that day." A September 2026 diner saw one main chef at the counter, two staff serving and one person in the kitchen. A regular's June 2025 note says the restaurant had recently been featured on TV. Reviews mention a Namba branch and 食堂ペスカ (September 2026). Tabelog Italian 100 in 2021.
chef_bio.philosophy: Daily market buying, "committed to maximizing the quality of the finest ingredients" (Tabelog shop text).
chef_bio.specialty: "Paitza" pastry pizza; carpaccio of three fish of the day.

anecdotes.text: "There's one main chef at the counter, two staff serving, and one person in the kitchen." — September 2026, a pre-birthday dinner on the Special Wagyu Tenderloin course (JPY 8,800).
"Since I was dining alone, they prepared all the dishes in single portions, which was a thoughtful touch." — October 2026, an early dinner at 3 PM.
"The pizza featured a flaky crust reminiscent of a pie, with a whole egg in the center, making it incredibly tasty." — October 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): ペスカ 心斎橋店 (PESCA Shinsaibashi)、イタリアン、大阪市中央区西心斎橋1-10-28 心斎橋Mビル 10F、四ツ橋駅3番出口から徒歩3分、心斎橋駅7番出口から徒歩5分、毎日15:00〜24:00、不定休、予約可 (アレルギーやデザートプレートの希望は予約のコメント欄へ)、カード可 (ICカードは2025年4月からPIN入力)、電子マネー可、QR不可、24席、貸切20〜50名、禁煙、持ち込み可、未成年不可、毎日市場に行くシェフ、名物はサクサクの「Paitza」、コース: Hirata Bokujo の豚などの90分飲み放題付き7,000円、ヨーロッパ産の鴨6,600円、特選和牛ヘレ8,800円 (記念日のメッセージプレート)、イタリアン 百名店 2021。口コミ(2025年6月〜2026年10月): マンションのような建物の最上階、1階に看板なし、外廊下のいちばん奥、カウンター約10席とテーブル2卓、カウンターにメインのシェフ、ホール2人、厨房1人 (2026年9月)、鮮魚3種のカルパッチョ、パイ生地のピザ、サバとカラスミのペペロンチーノ、鴨とポルチーニのクリームパスタ、黒毛和牛のガーリックライス、ワインは3,900円から、ひとり客には一人前ずつ作ってくれた、テレビで紹介されたという話 (2025年6月)、なんば店と食堂ペスカという姉妹店。

cultural_comfort.note: Book online or by phone; set courses can be chosen in advance, and the à la carte menu is long (2026). No English evidence found.
